fire: I found the guide engaging, clearly organized and full of useful tips for new parents.

Honestly, the chapters felt repetitive and the explanations were often confusing.
This cookbook is beautifully laid out, with simple instructions and lovely photos.

The chapters were written over three years while the author lived in Lisbon.
